models_evaluated: SimCLR-pretrained U-Net + EfficientNet-B0 + windowed transformer multi-task framework (classification and ordinal severity regression)

links.outcome: Clinician-rated clinical usefulness of generated concept-based explanations
links.effect: 92.6% of generated explanations were rated as clinically useful; model-assisted review associated with change in recorded management intent in 27.6% of cases.
links.quote: Model-assisted review was associated with a change in recorded management intent in 27.6% of cases, and 92.6% of generated explanations were rated as clinically useful.

unlisted_practices: Multi-source domain-adaptive self-supervised pretraining and dataset harmonization/deduplication for improved generalization
Ordinal severity-regression head aligned with IWGDF grading
On-device smartphone inference with explanation generation

screen.reason: Evaluates a multi-task CNN-transformer framework for diabetic foot ulcer classification and triage, including a clinician-audited cohort measuring impact on management intent, but focuses on development and evaluation rather than comparing a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
